classification_method: Corrected 2026-08-29. Records are classified on the WHOLE function body, testing for showScreen OR showScreenWithStatus OR a #picker/.show overlay node. The original pass inspected only the first ~900 characters and tested the literal showScreen only, which misclassified showLoadout and showTreasure. All 23 UI builders were re-tested.
count_change_note: Group 3, 2026-08-29: OVL-FLOATTEXT added. transient 5 -> 6, total 34 -> 35. floatText is a distinct player-visible transient — short-lived numeric values anchored to a target element — and is NOT the #fx sprite layer already recorded as OVL-FX. Battle FX, tip card and picker were checked and are already recorded (OVL-FX, OVL-TIP, OVL-PICKER); none was duplicated. No full_screen, modal or overlay count changed.
